title: Specify the exact model version (Seedance 2.5) in your setup to match expected…
content:
Specify the exact model version (Seedance 2.5) in your setup to match expected motion/realism.

Lock the generation to a single continuous shot by explicitly stating One continuous first-person rider POV shot. No cuts.

Control camera behavior by defining a physical mount constraint (camera stays physically attached to the rider’s head throughout).

Improve pacing and coherence in longer clips by timecoding the action beats (0–2s, 2–5s, 5–9s, 9–13s, 13–16s, 16–18s).

Prevent unwanted camera angles by adding a negative constraint like No external camera.

Avoid stylistic drift by explicitly banning undesired looks (No cartoon appearance; No plastic-looking creature).

Prevent unwanted temporal effects by explicitly stating No slow-motion.

Increase realism by calling out specific physical details and dynamics (realistic sand displacement, motion blur, dust hitting the lens, harsh warm desert sunlight, atmospheric haze).

Keep tone consistent by instructing how humor should be generated (humor must come naturally from the rider reacting to genuine danger).

es.content:
Especifica la versión exacta del modelo (Seedance 2.5) en tu configuración para que coincida con el movimiento y el realismo esperados.

Bloquea la generación a una sola toma continua indicando explícitamente One continuous first-person rider POV shot. No cuts.

Controla el comportamiento de la cámara definiendo una restricción de montaje físico (la cámara permanece físicamente sujeta a la cabeza del rider durante todo el tiempo).

Mejora el ritmo y la coherencia en clips más largos añadiendo marcas de tiempo para los beats de acción (0–2s, 2–5s, 5–9s, 9–13s, 13–16s, 16–18s).

Evita ángulos de cámara no deseados añadiendo una restricción negativa como No external camera.

Evita la deriva estilística prohibiendo explícitamente los looks no deseados (No cartoon appearance; No plastic-looking creature).

Evita efectos temporales no deseados indicando explícitamente No slow-motion.

Aumenta el realismo señalando detalles físicos y dinámicas específicas (realistic sand displacement, motion blur, dust hitting the lens, harsh warm desert sunlight, atmospheric haze).

Mantén la coherencia del tono indicando cómo debe generarse el humor (el humor debe surgir de forma natural de la reacción del rider ante un peligro real).

fr.content:
Spécifiez la version exacte du modèle (Seedance 2.5) dans votre configuration afin d’obtenir le mouvement et le réalisme attendus.

Verrouillez la génération sur un seul plan continu en indiquant explicitement One continuous first-person rider POV shot. No cuts.

Contrôlez le comportement de la caméra en définissant une contrainte de montage physique (la caméra reste physiquement attachée à la tête du rider pendant toute la durée).

Améliorez le rythme et la cohérence dans les clips plus longs en horodatant les temps forts de l’action (0–2s, 2–5s, 5–9s, 9–13s, 13–16s, 16–18s).

Évitez les angles de caméra indésirables en ajoutant une contrainte négative comme No external camera.

Évitez la dérive stylistique en interdisant explicitement les rendus non souhaités (No cartoon appearance; No plastic-looking creature).

Prévenez les effets temporels indésirables en indiquant explicitement No slow-motion.

Renforcez le réalisme en mentionnant des détails physiques et dynamiques précis (realistic sand displacement, motion blur, dust hitting the lens, harsh warm desert sunlight, atmospheric haze).

Conservez une tonalité cohérente en indiquant comment l’humour doit être généré (l’humour doit naître naturellement de la réaction du rider face à un danger réel).

ja.content:
期待される motion / realism に合わせるため、セットアップでは正確なモデルバージョン（Seedance 2.5）を指定してください。

生成を単一の連続ショットに固定するために、One continuous first-person rider POV shot. No cuts. と明示的に記述してください。

カメラの挙動は、物理的なマウント制約を定義することで制御します（カメラは終始ライダーの頭部に物理的に固定されている）。

長めのクリップでは、アクションのビートを timecode 化することで、テンポと一貫性を向上させます（0–2s, 2–5s, 5–9s, 9–13s, 13–16s, 16–18s）。

No external camera のような negative constraint を追加して、不要なカメラアングルを防ぎます。

No cartoon appearance; No plastic-looking creature. のように、望ましくない見た目を明示的に禁止して、スタイルのドリフトを避けます。

No slow-motion. と明示して、不要な時間効果を防ぎます。

realistic sand displacement, motion blur, dust hitting the lens, harsh warm desert sunlight, atmospheric haze のように、具体的な物理ディテールやダイナミクスを挙げて、リアリズムを高めます。

humor must come naturally from the rider reacting to genuine danger. と指示して、ユーモアがどのように生成されるべきかを定め、トーンの一貫性を保ちます。

ko.content:
기대되는 모션/리얼리즘과 맞추기 위해 설정에서 정확한 모델 버전(Seedance 2.5)을 지정하세요.

생성을 하나의 연속된 샷으로 고정하려면 One continuous first-person rider POV shot. No cuts.라고 명시적으로 적으세요.

카메라가 라이더의 머리에 물리적으로 계속 부착되어 있다는 물리적 장착 제약을 정의해 카메라 동작을 제어하세요.

더 긴 클립에서 페이싱과 일관성을 개선하려면 액션 비트를 시간 코드로 나누어 표시하세요(0–2s, 2–5s, 5–9s, 9–13s, 13–16s, 16–18s).

No external camera.와 같은 네거티브 제약을 추가해 원치 않는 카메라 앵글을 방지하세요.

원치 않는 스타일 변화가 생기지 않도록 바람직하지 않은 룩을 명시적으로 금지하세요(No cartoon appearance; No plastic-looking creature).

No slow-motion.이라고 명시해 원치 않는 시간적 효과를 방지하세요.

realistic sand displacement, motion blur, dust hitting the lens, harsh warm desert sunlight, atmospheric haze처럼 구체적인 물리적 디테일과 동작을 언급해 사실감을 높이세요.

유머가 어떻게 생성되어야 하는지 지시해 톤의 일관성을 유지하세요(유머는 라이더가 실제 위험에 반응하는 과정에서 자연스럽게 나와야 함).

pt.content:
Especifique a versão exata do modelo (Seedance 2.5) na sua configuração para corresponder ao motion/realism esperados.

Trave a geração em um único plano contínuo, declarando explicitamente One continuous first-person rider POV shot. No cuts.

Controle o comportamento da câmera definindo uma restrição física de montagem (a câmera permanece fisicamente presa à cabeça do rider durante todo o tempo).

Melhore o ritmo e a coerência em clipes mais longos ao timecodear os beats da ação (0–2s, 2–5s, 5–9s, 9–13s, 13–16s, 16–18s).

Evite ângulos de câmera indesejados adicionando uma restrição negativa como No external camera.

Evite deriva estilística proibindo explicitamente aparências indesejadas (No cartoon appearance; No plastic-looking creature).

Evite efeitos temporais indesejados declarando explicitamente No slow-motion.

Aumente o realismo destacando detalhes físicos e dinâmicas específicas (realistic sand displacement, motion blur, dust hitting the lens, harsh warm desert sunlight, atmospheric haze).

Mantenha a consistência do tom instruindo como o humor deve ser gerado (humor must come naturally from the rider reacting to genuine danger).

zh.content:
在你的设置中指定确切的模型版本（Seedance 2.5），以匹配预期的运动/真实感。

通过明确写出 One continuous first-person rider POV shot. No cuts.，将生成锁定为单一连续镜头。

通过定义物理安装约束来控制镜头行为（camera stays physically attached to the rider’s head throughout）。

通过对动作节拍进行时间编码来提升更长片段中的节奏感和连贯性（0–2s, 2–5s, 5–9s, 9–13s, 13–16s, 16–18s）。

通过添加负向约束来防止不想要的镜头角度，例如 No external camera。

通过明确禁止不希望出现的风格来避免风格漂移（No cartoon appearance; No plastic-looking creature）。

通过明确写出 No slow-motion. 来防止不想要的时间效果。

通过点出具体的物理细节和动态来提升真实感（realistic sand displacement, motion blur, dust hitting the lens, harsh warm desert sunlight, atmospheric haze）。

通过说明幽默应如何生成来保持语气一致（humor must come naturally from the rider reacting to genuine danger）。
